name: Orion
description: Web browser with tabs, history and an optional server-side proxy for sites that refuse to be framed.

name: NotNetflix
description: Movie and series streaming front-end. Titles are defined in content/movies.json (direct video files or embed URLs).

name: Spiceify
description: Music player for audio files and streaming-service embeds. Library defined in content/music.json.

name: GeForce NOW
description: Cloud gaming frame with gamepad, fullscreen and pointer-lock permissions and a live connection monitor.

embed.allow: autoplay; fullscreen; gamepad; keyboard-map; clipboard-read; clipboard-write; microphone; camera

name: Vapor
description: Game store and library. Launches HTML5 and web-hosted games in their own windows. Catalogue in content/games.json.

name: YouTube
description: Video browser using the official YouTube embed player. Search requires a YOUTUBE_API_KEY on the server.

name: App Store
description: Install, remove and launch apps, or add any website as a desktop app.

name: Notepad
description: Text and Markdown editor with server-side storage, upload and download.

name: Settings
description: Personalization, wallpaper, taskbar position, accounts and system information.

name: Vapor Player
description: Window host for games launched from Vapor.
